concepts.gloss_en: to return in repentance; the act of repenting/teshuvah

members.note: representative; the act of returning in repentance

concepts.gloss_en: the longing/yearning to return in repentance — a desire-state about teshuvah, not the act itself

members.note: distinct head 'כוסף' (longing); a state of desire directed at teshuvah, not the act of repenting (action-about-X ≠ X)

notes: Token overlap only via the shared infinitive phrase. 'כוסף לשוב בתשובה' is a yearning/desire concept whose head is 'כוסף'; per rule 4 an action/state about X is not X, so kept separate from the bare act 'לשוב בתשובה'. Also occur in different Torahs (lm1:135 vs lm1:31).
